What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Cylinder Head & Engine Block Plug Kit for Tracker & Sidekick

Direct Replacement

Qty 5 – Insert Plugs

ENGINE BLOCK

What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1993 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1993 – 1998 All Models
